notes.content:
Optimization: In the browser interface, separate the filter bar for the "Downloaded" and "Workshop" columns.
 New Mod: DragonUsurper.

Fix: Update built-in [Default] Mod.
 Optimization: When the settings interface is closed, the real-time FPS information in the upper left corner will not be hidden.

notes.title: [4.3.6] Fix the issue of cursor loss
notes.content: Fixed the issue of cursor loss caused by screen switching during program initialization or cursor replacement.

notes.title: [4.3.1] Mod Packaging Optimization
notes.content:
Change the packaging name of the Mod file to a unique ID for the convenience of loading multiple functional Mods simultaneously in the future.
Fixed a bug where enumeration types cannot be saved.

notes.title: [4.2.2] Internal code optimization
notes.content:
Optimize the core code, so some creative workshop objects will be re uploaded.
 Optimize the presentation of some components.

Fixed a bug where bones were misaligned after Snake scaling.
Optimize the help document.
Simplify project structure.

Repair 

When opening the program for the first time, if there is no subscription to Mod, a warning will pop up saying "Local creative workshop folder not found...".

Add a separate right-click 'Reset' menu for each Config.
 Add hover prompts for editable fields (such as bloom_Intensity in PostProcessingControllerConfig).
 Gradient increases the brightness setting.

Updated to Unity2022.3.10 due to toooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo many bugs in previous versions.
Fix bugs where editing environment, images, and other configurations are not updated.

Fix a bug where localized information cannot be read normally while offline.
Fixed a bug where the joint twisted when the cursor was redisplayed.

Optimize internal code.
Save localization information for downloaded mods.
Fix save failure issue.
Update to Unity 2022.3.4f1 LTS.
Improve shadow resolution.
Internal SDK changed.
SDK internal changed, some Mods using ThreeyesPlugins-Module scripts need to reupload.

Fix the issue of mouse penetration when opening the help window for the first time
Fix missing title characters in the Inspector window

notes.title: [3.7.0] Greatly Improved on UI！
notes.content:
Beautify the UI.
Refine the filter function of Workshop section.
Show help window on first launch.
Add a transparent ground that can receive shadows (the ground can be switched on and off through EnvironmentControllerConfig-isUseGround toggle)

notes.title: [3.5.0] Fix lagging and other problems
notes.content:
Fix lagging problem. If you are facing the same problem, try turning off 'Vertical Sync' and increase the 'Target Frame Rate' to 125 or higher in 'Setting Window'.
Improve performance.
Open main window with single click.
Set default angle to 30°.


Thanks for Scott's great advice!

Update UI appearance.
Update Hair plugin version to 0.10.0-exp.1.

notes.title: Beta verion with workshop support is released!
notes.content:
Beta version is now release! Change your current version into beta branch (Tutorial) to start testing the new features and bugs!

Here's something new about beta version:

 You can borwse and download mod from workshop.
 You can custom your own config into files, which will be saved to Steam Cloud. 
 You can use SDK to upload your mods.
